name: assistant.bd
description: AI Operating System: No-code automation + AI agents + CRM

scripts.build:active: npm run -w @assistant.bd/types type-check && npm run -w @assistant.bd/ai-core build && npm run -w @assistant.bd/api-gateway build && npm run -w @assistant.bd/workflow-engine build && npm run -w @assistant.bd/ai-orchestrator build && npm run -w @assistant.bd/web build
scripts.test:active: npm run -w @assistant.bd/api-gateway test && npm run -w @assistant.bd/workflow-engine test && npm run -w @assistant.bd/ai-orchestrator test
scripts.lint:active: npm run -w @assistant.bd/api-gateway lint && npm run -w @assistant.bd/workflow-engine lint && npm run -w @assistant.bd/ai-orchestrator lint && npm run -w @assistant.bd/web lint
scripts.type-check:active: npm run -w @assistant.bd/types type-check && npm run -w @assistant.bd/ai-core type-check && npm run -w @assistant.bd/api-gateway type-check && npm run -w @assistant.bd/workflow-engine type-check && npm run -w @assistant.bd/ai-orchestrator type-check && npm run -w @assistant.bd/web type-check
scripts.ci:active: npm run lint:active && npm run type-check:active && npm run test:active && npm run build:active
